issue: The registered APPLICABLE_METHODOLOGY Scope Unit lacks a separately targeted Goal. R1213 defines the similarly named Projection and excludes treating the Projection itself as a Scope Unit.
scope: One instance Declaration Draft; future Scope Unit source migration. Engine Goal gaps are separate.
question: Retain a distinct hosting Scope Unit, or retire that Scope Unit and retain only the Projection?
status: Resolved; preparation updated; Current structure unchanged.
decision: Applicable Methodology remains a special Projection. Withdraw its Scope Unit Declaration Draft and plan retirement of the separate APPLICABLE_METHODOLOGY Scope Unit; no separate Scope Unit Goal is needed.
